title: Grounded
provenance: Reported by abadu223 (highball-db#928, 2026-11-02), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 8 minutes: singleplayer and Xbox Live crossplay worked after two changes to the game's DLLs in Maine/Binaries/Win64. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M3 Pro with DXMT, multiplayer included, after two changes to the game's own DLLs.

knownIssues.cause: SpeechSynthWrapper.SetPreferredVoice throws because Wine's speech API returns no voices
knownIssues.fix: rename SpeechSynthWrapper.dll in Maine/Binaries/Win64 to SpeechSynthWrapper.dll.bak

knownIssues.cause: under Windows 10 the game loads PlayFab Party's PartyWin.dll, which fails under Wine
knownIssues.fix: in Maine/Binaries/Win64, rename PartyWin.dll to PartyWin.dll.bak and put a copy of PartyWin7.dll in its place named PartyWin.dll
